notes: Mapped onto AppContext assemble_dock of an 8-leaf DockNode split tree plus adjust_focused_dock_split in an isolated AppContext. Measures keyboard/API splitter resize that rebuilds chrome. Does not measure pointer-drag splitter, dock tear-off, or a host pointer-pump loop.
